title: Back to New Orleans: parade pay and the trumpeter who passed for white
summary: He repeats the 75-cent parade story and tries without success to recall the name of the light-skinned trumpet player who would not teach Black pupils.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: That was in New Orleans. I think you mentioned before that there was a trumpet player in New Orleans who passed for white and wouldn't take any colored music students. Do you remember his name?
It was -- yeah, his brother was a clarinet player, too. He was in Philadelphia the last time I saw him. Oh, God. You're bringing back some real oldies on me now.
Okay, we'll make notes of these when we come back. Maybe they'll come back a little later on.
I know we're kind of jumping around from --
Pillar to post, yeah. I can't think of his name right now. It'll probably come to me as we're talking.
